title: Stream transcript (valid): SESSION_INIT followed by SESSION_CAPABILITIES
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with a SESSION_INIT entry followed by a SESSION_CAPABILITIES entry advertising SESSION_ACK support. Validates capability advertisement after session establishment. Does not require live TCP/QUIC transport.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
SESSION_CAPABILITIES payload is 2 bytes of capability flags (CAP_SESSION_ACK = 0x0001).
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
